review_scope: Technical source-ID, coordinate-containment and demographic-join review for a prototype; no partner or field validation.

mappings.review_note: Station ID, name and coordinates inspected against the observed NEA WBGT response. The source coordinates must fall inside this exact MP2019 planning-area polygon; the loader rechecks containment on every startup. The Census planning-area total is joined by exact normalized name. No claim of uniform heat or population-weighted coverage.
